original_target.title: Polynomial bounds for the graph diameter of polytopes

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original undirected vertex-edge graph diameter for all bounded full-dimensional polytopes, polynomial in n+d. Black–Xue Theorem1.1 is exponential lower bound only for coherent monotone paths with a chosen objective. It leaves unrestricted shortest paths untouched. Circuit walks, unbounded polyhedra and hardness of computing a diameter are different from a superpolynomial bounded-polytope edge-diameter family. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
